entries.value: To win the love or possession of a particular person
To obtain riches and personal wealth
To win political power or a particular title or office
To obtain glory and fame for a skill or great deed
To gain a particular property, estate, or holy relic
To go to or explore a far-off place — Jerusalem, Constantinople, Avalon
To become a member of a difficult or prestigious calling
To kill or utterly ruin a hated rival
To bring down an institution, family, or faith
